# Independent Career Preview reference

This Set50 corpus was derived before Set50 Go implementation from the frozen contract `5cf347a9e402ae46e4682728733dc637d997a1f702d11ddd65c9f8ebd04efeeb` and copied existing independent Python producers. `input_index.json` binds all 89 inputs, including transitive engine/condition/manifest/DNA/portrait dependencies, Career arithmetic and prefix equations, old Preview fixtures, public Set49 evidence and frozen prose. The frozen copies retain their original bytes despite later source-document status updates.

`generate.py` emits complete modeled Pair/Recipe/condition preimages, seed preimages, canonical engine Input and InputID, frozen-engine transcript/result digest, full enclosing result digest and fixed typed portraits. It uses the original Manifest and declared original birth, and applies Totals.XP once. Selection is canonical; the declared case list does not search seeds for preferred outcomes. The same engine-v1 producer remains unchanged. The reference generation calls it to derive expected transcripts; this does not claim to measure the shipping job's required Simulate plus full-Digest two-call behavior.

All composition authority, sessions, Career events and assignments are explicitly modeled. No case proves an admission, genuine signature/finality, live session, journal write, actual race, deadline, cancellation, render or GUI outcome. The public Set49 evidence is a pinned future acceptance source, not an authorization/import mechanism. `schema.status` deliberately accepts only the two pinned legacy fixture Pins: this is a finite fixture validator, not a generic production grammar or an actual-Set49 source validator. A public Pair cannot mint a trusted owner. The synthetic structural total-256 Pair is a scalar-bound positive only, without an asserted matching owner prefix.

`schema.py` validates closed typed shapes and cheap arithmetic. An optional modeled owner argument checks one exact captured Current prefix and totals; it does not re-simulate the transcript. Its wrong-prefix controls compare different capture authorities, not a refresh of an existing private token. The separate lifecycle models preserve the captured token and Pair across later same-ms awards and unrelated source append as required. The two exact old Set47 engine function source segments are retained unchanged for provenance; a new-context wrapper preserves the inherited Preview minima, continuity, recovery, finish and signed-field grammar. Transcript predicate negatives recompute the outer result digest where needed. Request/response parse inputs exclude their terminating LF; their byte allowance reserves that LF. Negative recipes charge actual whitespace and reject decoded duplicate aliases, unsafe numbers, arrays, unknown/null fields, old/new type confusion and over-limit frames. Successful protocol correlation binds original full View, prior trusted activation, selected job tuple and immutable terminal bytes. Portrait correlation also binds the selected job even when another job has the same deterministic result.

Transport self-checks run with engine/full-result-codec, file/source-read, subprocess/Argon-launch and socket/network entry points trapped. The producer has no source-journal, RPC or Argon API. Bounded manifest/condition arithmetic and canonical hashes remain permitted. The old generators are imported only for their pinned pure functions; their standalone corpus/mining/Argon entry points are never run.

`state_models.py` contains symbolic owner, epoch, capture, lane, lost-ACK, native selection and reciprocal cache models. Model counters describe required behavior, not observations of real runtime entry points. Initial draft and arithmetic/schema/generator: checkpoint_envelope. State refinement: checkpoint_design_audit, derived from the same frozen contract with only standard-library helpers. Independent nonauthor review is recorded outside this tree by checkpoint_tool/root.

Regenerate with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=<fixed> TZ=<zone> python3 -B -S generate.py --write <new-file>`; files are created exclusively. Use `--check corpus.json` for exact regeneration comparison. `verify_reference.py corpus.json` performs author self-checks. `verification.json` records two Python versions, distinct hash seeds/time zones and complete byte equality. `source_index.json` pins authored source and `file_index.json` pins the complete held tree except itself. Prior candidates and logs are retained outside this tree under `set50-reference-attempts`; they are not overwritten or relabelled final. No old v1 corpus is changed. Runtime comparison remains blocked until root reviews, freezes and commits this reference-only tree.
